Messages.Author: KimSantos
Messages.Body:
Player L controls Lutz (with only 1 pool), his prey is Player P (with only 1 pool). Player J plays Justicar Retribution and wins the referendum. There is a Tension in the Ranks on the game.

Who is ousted from the game?

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Both L and P are ousted. J gets 2 victory points and 12 pool.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Hi there.

The referendum is successful, so Lutz' ability will trigger ( groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/99411d8271b78165 ).

Then, apply the effects of successful referendum: Lutz burns, his controller is ousted. L is ousted.
Then, after successful referendum, P burns 1 pool and is ousted.

L's predator gains 2 VPs and 12 pool.
